scripts.build:bt: mkdir -p bin && swiftc bluetooth-bridge/AirPodsOperation.swift bluetooth-bridge/AirPodsNativeRequest.swift bluetooth-bridge/main.swift -o bin/oms-bt-bridge
scripts.build:hud: mkdir -p bin && swiftc mac-hud/main.swift -framework Cocoa -framework PDFKit -framework Quartz -framework AVFoundation -framework WebKit -o bin/oms-mac-hud
scripts.build:ctl: mkdir -p bin && swiftc -O mac-ctl/HidMathAndScreenBounds.swift mac-ctl/LaserOverlayController.swift mac-ctl/main.swift -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -framework CoreGraphics -framework QuartzCore -o bin/oms-mac-ctl
